en.headline: Police arrest 47-year-old woman over suspected fake US$100 at San Po Kong bank
en.dek: A Standard Chartered branch on Tai Wo Street alerted officers after staff found one counterfeit note among 71 US dollar bills a customer tried to deposit.
body: Police arrested a 47-year-old woman surnamed Sun on Monday afternoon on suspicion of uttering counterfeit currency after she attempted to deposit US dollar bills at a bank in San Po Kong.

Officers said bank staff at the Standard Chartered branch on Tai Wo Street called police around 3:18 pm after discovering that one of the US$100 notes among the 71 bills she presented was suspected to be fake. She had 70 notes of US$100 and one of US$50.

The woman was detained for further enquiries. The case was handed to the Wong Tai Sin District Crime Squad. Under the Crimes Ordinance, uttering counterfeit banknotes carries a maximum penalty of 14 years' imprisonment.

zh.headline: 新蒲崗銀行疑存入偽美鈔 47歲女子被捕
zh.dek: 大有街渣打銀行職員發現顧客擬存入的71張美鈔中有一張100元屬偽鈔後報警，警方以涉嫌行使偽製紙幣拘捕她。
body: 警方周一下午以涉嫌行使偽製紙幣，拘捕一名47歲姓孫女子。事發於新蒲崗大有街一間渣打銀行。
警方表示，下午約3時18分，銀行職員報案，指一名女子擬將71張美鈔存入個人戶口，當中包括70張100元及一張50元，職員點算時發現其中一張100元美鈔懷疑屬偽鈔。
該名女子現正被扣留調查，案件交由黃大仙警區刑事調查隊跟進。根據《刑事罪行條例》，行使偽製紙幣最高可判監禁14年。
